title: BESSELY resweep: 93 of 93 on the grid the repair was solved against
status_plain: BESSELY is closed and signed off. A 93-case (x, n) grid around BESSELY(2.5,1) was re-scored against live Excel 16.0 b19929 through the repaired shipping kernel and returned 93 exact typed bit matches with 0 drifts, up from 92 of 93. The build is stated in the section header immediately above the figure, and it is b19929 - not the 20131 that most catalogue figures carry. The 93 rows are NOT held out: the five coefficient corrections were root-caused by solving per-coefficient deltas as linear systems against those same live-Excel bit witnesses, so the validation re-scores the fitting set. No held-out BESSELY corpus exists. Two OxFunc documents contradict each other about BESSELY's state: the Excel-math-deviation catalogue still lists BESSELY order >= 1 as "still 1e8-1e11 ULP off" in its inverse-class section. That sentence is stale - it predates the repair - but both documents are live, so the contradiction is published here rather than silently resolved.
